info.title: Event Command Center - Slice 6 implemented occupancy snapshot
info.description: Slice 6 internal read extended by the FINALIZED Slice 7 VERSIONED UPDATES contract. Capacity remains a registration cap, not gate admission authority. The dedicated committed attendance ledger revision and authoritative as_of read timestamp are required. Socket.IO delivery is specified in API_CONTRACT.md; REST remains authoritative. No corrections or checkout.

get.summary: Read coherent attendance and occupancy for an owned or assigned-admin event.
get.description: Current Organizer owner or active assigned EVENT_ADMIN only. Current authority is rechecked under the existing event/session/assignment lock order. Existing CHECK_IN ledger is authoritative. No capacity admission lock, cache, mutable counter or projection table. No query/body fields; no mutation/idempotency/revision headers.

200.description: Private no-store/no-referrer snapshot. No occupancy disclosure through discovery.

400.description: VALIDATION: query/body fields are not accepted.

404.description: EVENT_NOT_FOUND: unknown, malformed or out-of-scope event. Gate/Volunteer/Participant authority alone is insufficient.

503.description: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: required database or denial audit unavailable.

occupied.description: Registrations currently INSIDE, derived from committed CHECK_IN ledger entries.

registered.description: Active REGISTERED registrations, distinct from occupied.

capacity.description: Configured registration cap. Null for legacy unconfigured drafts.

remaining.description: capacity - occupied; negative is valid. Null without capacity.

utilization_percentage.description: occupied / capacity * 100 rounded to two decimal places; values above 100 are valid. Null without capacity.

last_attendance_at.description: Latest accepted attendance time, not the snapshot calculation time.

calculated_at.description: Database statement time of the coherent read.

revision.description: Dedicated per-event committed append-only AttendanceTransition count, never Event.revision. Accepted transitions advance once; duplicate, rejected and rolled-back scans do not.

as_of.description: UTC database statement time of the coherent authoritative read, equal to calculated_at; not attendance occurrence or commit time.
